name: 04-earl-grey-monoline-cursive
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / text-localization. Edit input image 1 as a SURGICAL TYPOGRAPHY-ONLY change for an elegant minimalist product catalogue. Preserve exactly the entire underlying photograph: cup position and scale, dome lid shape, clean exterior rim/flange, green matcha/beige milk and thin amber syrup bottom, creamy cold foam, mascot girl and bunny with exactly two ears, condensation, light/shadow, background colour and texture. Do not restyle or regenerate the drink. Preserve full cup and existing frame, portrait exactly 1086x1448.
Completely remove the existing oversized bold rounded top text and replace ONLY that top typography with the specified elegant type treatment. No rounded bold type remains. All new letters solid muted rose #B8496C. Airy centered composition, safe top and side margins, no overlapping lines, clean gap above dome. Exact words must be clean, correctly spelled, highly legible. No extra words, pricing, badges, claims, props, flourishes beyond letterforms, divider rules, ornaments or watermark. No change to small text printed on cup sticker.
NEW TYPOGRAPHY: Minimalist MONOLINE cursive on two lines: exact first line 'Earl Grey', exact second line 'Matcha Latte'. Delicate uniform thin-but-readable strokes, softly connected letters, subtle rightward slant, simple open elegant loops, intentionally almost no thick/thin contrast. Modern understated handwritten monoline script with ample air, not brush lettering or formal copperplate. Title width about 60–65% of image. Beneath, small simple clean sans-serif brand line '128am Cafe'. No bold original font, no fancy swashes or ornaments.
visual_qa: Passed: legible exact title and brand line; requested cursive style; photograph, product, clean rim, thin syrup and full cup preserved.
